mechanism_narrative: The collapse in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES to -70.9 and -48.9 removes routine commuting and daytime population from retail corridors, so RETAIL_REC remains below its prior 28-day mean over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is greater than or equal to its prior 28-day mean while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both remain below -40.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility exceeds +20 percent above baseline, stay-at-home orders are binding and discretionary retail trips are curtailed, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the following week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases in any week when RESIDENTIAL is above +20 percent baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A wide gap between collapsing PARKS and less-collapsed GROCERY_PHARM means households are eliminating non-essential outings while still buying essentials, which suppresses discretionary RETAIL_REC for two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is greater than or equal to its prior 28-day mean while PARKS < -40 and GROCERY_PHARM > -30.

mechanism_narrative: In a national lockdown enforcement regime, WORKPLACES below -40 removes commuter demand and shortens retail operating hours, driving RETAIL_REC further below its prior 28-day mean over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean exceeds its prior 28-day mean while WORKPLACES remains below -40.

mechanism_narrative: The abrupt fall in GROCERY_PHARM from +5.3 to -26.7 signals consolidation of essential trips; as households minimize all outings, discretionary RETAIL_REC falls over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is greater than or equal to its prior 28-day mean while GROCERY_PHARM remains below -20.

mechanism_narrative: Spring normally lifts retail and recreation, but the simultaneous -51.4 PARKS collapse shows outdoor leisure is confined; the seasonal uptick is absent, so RETAIL_REC stays below its prior 28-day mean.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean exceeds its prior 28-day mean while PARKS remains below -40.

mechanism_narrative: The joint collapse of TRANSIT and WORKPLACES creates a reinforcement loop: fewer commuters reduce transit use, which further reduces retail street traffic; this interaction keeps RETAIL_REC depressed for two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean exceeds its prior 28-day mean while TRANSIT < -50 and WORKPLACES < -40.

mechanism_narrative: A RESIDENTIAL surge above +20 combined with RETAIL_REC already below -60 indicates lockdown has moved from advisory to enforced, keeping retail near trough for the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean exceeds its prior 28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL > +20 and RETAIL_REC < -60.
